candidate_gate_config.calibration_source: P1 validation trained-256 raw-signal support limits; P2 physical margins and jump bounds are provisional engineering policy

config.same_scenario_baseline_contract: prepared P1 fixed-ROI replay of the exact same frames and references

frozen_test_audit.correlation_caveat: Nominal sample-level bound; CrackMNIST augmentations may be correlated.

crackmnist_raw_signal_evidence.interpretation: single-image signal audit only; no physical sequence or adaptive-ROI accuracy claim
crackmnist_raw_signal_evidence.threshold_source: P1 validation only plus provisional engineering policy

validation.correlation_caveat: Nominal sample-level bound; CrackMNIST augmentations may be correlated.

crackmnist.independence_caveat: official augmented split lacks source-frame identifiers and is not a physical trajectory

dummy2.load_phase_derivation: recorded force ordering and cycle signals

candidate_tip_xy_mm.meaning: ungated frozen-decoder fusion in absolute specimen coordinates
candidate_tip_xy_mm.normalization: each head crosses LegacySideAdapter, then RoiObservation.from_decoder_heads applies the frozen fusion weight

finite_grid_fraction.meaning: share of finite interpolated DIC grid values

head_disagreement_fraction.meaning: physical distance between frozen decoder heads
head_disagreement_fraction.normalization: physical head distance / applied ROI physical diagonal
head_disagreement_fraction.source: absolute mask and coordinate head points

mask_mean_score.meaning: bounded neural region score; not a calibrated probability

region_selection_score.normalization: none; units depend on the frozen region rule

historical_williams_evidence.reason: No independent ground truth and no residual-before/after contract; the historical correction is therefore not eligible for P2 adoption.

split_invariants: All frames, sides, chunks, resolutions and augmentations of one experiment_group_id remain in the same split.
Physical tip coordinates are derived from an accepted calibration, never entered independently by hand.
Only accepted annotations qualify as ground truth.

optimization_decision.reason: Safety and failure gates pass, but the 40-mm adaptive policy does not improve same-frame localization against fixed P1 and independent sequence labels remain unavailable.
